project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 9 of 9 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Peatling Magna qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ALL SAINTS and Churchyard cross in All Saints' churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Peatling Magna: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Peatling Magna offers CHURCH OF ALL SAINTS, Churchyard cross in All Saints' churchyard, CROSS BASE IN CHURCHYARD within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ALL SAINTS
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ALL SAINTS and Churchyard cross in All Saints' churchyard, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Churchyard cross in All Saints' churchyard
